landing.masthead_heading: A modern foundation for Node.js web apps
landing.services_intro: Opinionated building blocks inspired by Rails—without leaving the Express ecosystem.
landing.service_dev_body: TypeScript, structured routing, validators, mailers, and Prisma are wired so you focus on business logic instead of repetitive plumbing.
landing.service_admin_body: User management, roles, features, and permissions ship with seeds you can adapt as the product grows.
landing.service_secure_body: Sessions, password hashing, email-based activation, and clear API auth patterns keep onboarding and audits straightforward.
landing.highlights_intro: Concrete pieces you can extend—admin UI, APIs, and patterns that stay familiar if you already know Rails.
landing.highlight1_body: Controllers, views, mailers, jobs, and folder conventions echo Ruby on Rails 6 so teams can navigate the codebase with muscle memory.
landing.highlight2_body: Prisma, mail adapters, optional Turso, notifications (SSE + FCM hooks), and Vue islands on admin screens—add what each product needs without fork fatigue.
landing.highlight3_body: The core is split and the architecture rebuilt for clarity; server-side AI assistant wiring ships as a first-class module you can trim or extend.
landing.about_intro: Three chapters from a Rails-shaped experiment on Node to a framework that chases the same developer experience—now with room for AI and specialized stacks.
landing.about_milestone1_body: We bootstrapped Irwin with basic building blocks and a file and folder layout aligned with Ruby on Rails 6 so structure stays predictable from day one.
landing.about_milestone2_body: We layered in newer libraries and feature modules tailored to real projects—extra flexibility without giving up the convention-over-configuration spirit.
landing.about_milestone3_body: Riding the AI wave, we separated the framework core, reworked architecture, and pushed syntax familiarity with Rails to about 95% so ergonomics stay front and center.
landing.team_intro: Maintainers who prefer boring, well-structured backends over throwaway prototypes.
landing.team_close: Contributions are welcome—docs, typings, or optional modules (queues, SSO, CMS). Open the README when you bootstrap your next build.
